description: Set up the Integrations module infrastructure: seed data, storage functions, AppContext integration, route, sidebar nav item, and the Integrations page shell with four tabs (API Endpoints, Webhooks, Integrations, Data Sync).
steps: Create src/data/seedIntegrations.js with deterministic seed data covering: (a) apiEndpoints - mock REST endpoints for nurses, placements, documents, communications with method/path/description/status/responseDelay/errorRate, (b) apiKeys - array of mock API keys with id/name/key/status/created/lastUsed, (c) webhooks - registered webhooks with id/url/events/secret/status/createdAt, (d) webhookDeliveryLog - webhook deliveries with id/webhookId/event/status/timestamp/responseCode/payload, (e) integrations - third-party integration cards (NHS Jobs, NMC Online, DBS Check Service, Visa Tracking) with id/name/provider/status/apiKey/syncFrequency/lastSync/syncHistory, (f) syncStatus - per-integration sync status objects with lastSync/status/conflicts. Use the seededRandom pattern from src/data/seedReports.js.

Add storage functions in src/lib/storage.js: getIntegrations/saveIntegrations, getApiEndpoints/saveApiEndpoints, getApiKeys/saveApiKeys, getWebhooks/saveWebhooks, getWebhookDeliveryLog/saveWebhookDeliveryLog, getSyncStatus/saveSyncStatus. Add initialization block in initializeData() that seeds integrations data if not present.

Add state to src/context/AppContext.jsx: import the new get/save functions, add useState for integrations, apiEndpoints, apiKeys, webhooks, webhookDeliveryLog, syncStatus. Add useCallback update functions for each. Add all to the context value object.

Create src/pages/Integrations.jsx page component with four tabs: 'API Endpoints' (icon: Server), 'Webhooks' (icon: Webhook), 'Integrations' (icon: Puzzle), 'Data Sync' (icon: RefreshCw). Follow the exact tab UI pattern from src/pages/Reports.jsx. Each tab renders a placeholder div for now.
Add route in src/App.jsx: import Integrations page and add <Route path='/integrations' element={<Integrations />} /> inside the Layout route.

Add navigation item in src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx: import the Puzzle icon from lucide-react, add { path: '/integrations', label: 'Integrations', icon: Puzzle } to NAV_ITEMS array (between Communications and Settings).

Create a new git branch 'stage-11-integrations-api' from current HEAD and commit all changes with message 'feat: Stage 11 - Integrations module infrastructure (seed data, storage, context, routing, nav)'
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with zero errors
npm run lint passes with no errors
The /integrations route is registered in App.jsx
The sidebar shows an Integrations nav item with Puzzle icon
The Integrations page renders with four tabs that can be switched
Seed data is initialized in localStorage on first load
AppContext provides integrations state and update functions
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform && npm run build' and confirm it succeeds
Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform && npm run lint' and confirm no errors
